constraints: langID receives the automatically generated dictionary IDs (unique, based on file names) used with SPELL SET CURRENT DICTIONARY.
langFiles receives the dictionary file names without extensions.

langNames receives the language names in the current application language, suffixed with "- Hunspell"; unrecognized/custom dictionary files return "N/A - Hunspell" (the dictionary can still be used via its returned ID).

overloadMerges.note: autoparse defaulted all three params to direction:"in" from the blanket rule; the doc parameter table marks langID, langFiles and langNames all as "<-" (out) -- they are filled/sized by the command, none are inputs.
